faq.question: How do I migrate my existing patient data?
faq.answer: We handle everything. Our clinical onboarding team will batch-import your records from your legacy systems or Excel sheets with zero data loss.

faq.question: Is MediKloud HMS ABDM compliant?
faq.answer: 100% Compliant. MediKloud is Tier-1 ABDM-compliant. Create ABHA IDs and link health records natively right from the dashboard.

faq.question: What happens if the internet goes down?
faq.answer: You stay operational. Our offline-resilient architecture lets you continue charting without interruption. Data syncs automatically the second you are back online.

faq.question: Can it be customized for my specialty?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We provide pre-built templates for 15+ specialties (Cardio, Ortho, etc.) and customizable SOAP notes to match your exact workflow.

faq.question: Are there any hidden maintenance AMC fees?
faq.answer: Zero. We use a transparent subscription model. All over-the-air updates, security protocols, and system maintenance are included for free.

faq.question: How much training does my staff need?
faq.answer: Under 2 hours. The interface is as intuitive as a smartphone app. Most reception staff are fully proficient after a single onboarding session.

faq.question: Does it support multi-doctor clinics?
faq.answer: Yes. You can instantly add new doctors, set up specialized department desks, and configure strict role-based access for your entire staff.

faq.question: What are the hardware requirements?
faq.answer: Anything with a browser. Because we are a cloud-native OS, there are no bulky local servers required. It runs flawlessly on your existing laptops or tablets.

faq.question: Who owns my clinical data?
faq.answer: You retain 100% ownership. MediKloud acts strictly as a secure custodian. You own your data and can export your complete records at any time.

faq.question: Does it handle GST and TPA automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. Generate real-time GST-compliant invoices and track TPA insurance claims and pending settlements in one unified financial dashboard.
